reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively instructs viewers to join and fund a purported passive-income trading program through a referral link and Bitcoin payment, while presenting account balances and recurring trading bonuses as evidence of returns. It also directs viewers to choose a sponsor-linked left or right position and later refer friends, making participation dependent on a recruitment structure rather than merely explaining financial concepts.

citations.quote: How to register and fund your Mirror Trading International account.
scan the QR code or carefully copy the bitcoin address to your wallet Make the payment by sending the bitcoin
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
You will need to confirm this with your sponsor.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

opening.argument: The material does not promise a guaranteed return or say that a loss is impossible. It describes account registration, Bitcoin funding, and statements showing trading results; those instructions alone do not establish what returns, if any, a viewer would receive. The description calls the opportunity “Passive Income,” but that phrase is not a quantified or unconditional guarantee. Without treating promotional wording as proof of a promised outcome, the evidence supports viewing this as an account walkthrough rather than concluding that the creator deceptively guaranteed profits.

citations.quote: How to register and fund your Mirror Trading International account.
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
The MOST Exciting Passive Income Opportunity

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to funding instructions and daily statements, but those establish a described account process and reporting cadence, not that returns were guaranteed or that the statements prove profits. The sponsor and referral references show how registration is attributed and how a link may be shared; they do not, by themselves, establish deceptive earnings claims.

citations.quote: Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is more than a neutral explanation of trading concepts: it is explicitly titled as a guide to registering and funding the account, tells viewers to send Bitcoin, and describes daily trade-result statements. The description’s passive-income framing gives that operational walkthrough promotional context. The absence of an explicit guarantee does not make instructions to fund the promoted trading program merely educational.

citations.quote: How to register and fund your Mirror Trading International account.
Make the payment by sending the bitcoin
The MOST Exciting Passive Income Opportunity

opening.argument: The video is structured as an operational walkthrough: it explains how to register, complete profile details, submit a Bitcoin payment, and view account statements. Those are concrete interface tasks, not market analysis or a demonstration of a trading strategy. The opening frame likewise presents it as a guide to registering and funding an account. A tutorial can describe a service’s process without proving that the service is safe, but this material does not itself establish fraud merely by demonstrating that process.

citations.quote: Once you have done this click on the register button.
please login to the back office at myMTIclub.com then click on the profile button to upload your proof of address.
Go back to your Dashboard and confirm that your Bitcoin is now in the trading account.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution emphasizes that the tutorial includes joining and funding, but that describes its subject matter, not proof that the demonstrated process is fraudulent. It also characterizes account balances and statements as evidence of returns; the narration says viewers can inspect statements of trade results, while the cited material does not establish that those records demonstrate realized or withdrawable profits.

citations.quote: You can also login to your back office to see the results and your statements.
Click on the View option to see your daily statement.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough is not detached technical education: it directs viewers through registration and Bitcoin funding for the named account, and the description promotes a passive-income opportunity. Calling the steps a tutorial does not change that the tutorial operationally enables participation in the promoted program.

citations.quote: How to register and fund your Mirror Trading International account.
scan the QR code or carefully copy the bitcoin address to your wallet Make the payment by sending the bitcoin
The MOST Exciting Passive Income Opportunity

opening.argument: The strongest grounded reading is promotion of an account-based service with a described registration and funding workflow. The video does show a Bitcoin payment step, so this is not simply a no-deposit service; however, the supplied narration does not state a guaranteed return, a required recruitment quota, or that referral income is necessary to earn. It says viewers may refer friends and describes statements of trading results. Those details warrant scrutiny, but they do not alone establish that the service is a scam rather than a promoted service whose legitimacy the supplied material cannot independently verify.

citations.quote: You will need to confirm this with your sponsor.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s account of funding is accurate, but a deposit instruction does not itself establish deception. Its recruitment-structure point relies on sponsor and left/right-position references; the narration does mention those, yet it does not say in the cited passages that referrals are required or that a viewer’s earnings depend on building a downline. The referral instruction is expressly conditional: “Should you wish” to refer friends.

citations.quote: You will need to confirm this with your sponsor.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited text instructs viewers to fund a trading account with Bitcoin and confirms that the video is promoting participation, not merely discussing ordinary commerce. The signup’s sponsor-linked left/right placement and the dashboard’s team, direct-referral, and binary-bonus fields give the referral mechanism more context than an incidental share link. The material need not state a guaranteed return for the combination to warrant a scam verdict.
